title: rodi's Renewable Resources Mod
description: This project adds the sifter block!
body: This mod adds the sifter block - put a hopper on top to sift dirt, gravel, and sand! put a hopper on the bottom to collect the loot! the loot varies between each block, and to craft the sifter you need 7 planks like upside down leggings, iron bars in the middle, and a hopper on top!
